method: Original closed cuirasses with real neck/waist/arm apertures follow the four effective owned icons. Fixed plates, belt, trim, rivets, scarf and cape retain existing owned pixels. One newly generated cream/beige fur tile covers a continuous closed curved mantle; FUR_PROMPT.json records exact prompt, built-in tool and source. No existing raster changed.
limitations: Simplified shared cuirass outline, static cape/scarf, small repeated material samples, faceted trim and simplified continuous fur mantle; no worn fitting or author acceptance.
material_note: Red/navy icon samples preserve minimum alpha253/252. New fur is fully opaque and byte-identical to the generated output.
